title: Sweefts SMP modpack
description: Sweefts SMP Modpack is a lightweight Fabric modpack that focuses on performance, pvp and quality of life improvements for the Sweefts SMP server. It has optimization mods like Sodium, Lithium and FerriteCore to improve gameplay and FPS, and PvP and utility
body:
Welcome to the Sweefts SMP Modpack, a modpack made for the Sweefts SMP server.

It is built for performance, better player versus player (PvP) combat and a nicer experience when playing with others.

This modpack has mods that make the game run smoother and faster.

Some of these mods are Sodium, Lithium and FerriteCore.

They help make the game less laggy and boost frames per second (FPS).

It also has mods that make the game easier to play.

These include Mod Menu, Mouse Tweaks and Simple Voice Chat.

The modpack has mods that help with PvP and survival.

Some of these mods are:

* Hardcore Hearts

* Status Effects Plus

* TotemCounter

* ukus Armor HUD

These mods help you in battle.

The modpack also has mods that make the game look better.

Some of these mods are Fullbright UB and the Spunky PVP Texture Pack.

They give the game a look that is good, for PvP.

The Sweefts SMP Modpack is made to make playing Minecraft faster smoother and more fun.

You can use it when you are grinding, doing PvP exploring or playing with friends.

The Sweefts SMP Modpack helps make your Minecraft experience better.
